title: Lexical retriever v2 with stop words on by default and v1 frozen
description:
## Purpose

Ship lexical retrieval v2 with stop words on by default, while keeping v1 byte-for-byte reproducible.

## Scope

- **v1 frozen:** `PerLabelLexicalRetrieval` keeps its name, version `1`, empty config and fingerprint (old artifacts and the cached answers behind arm B depend on it).
- **v2:** vendored, versioned stop-word list `en-v1` that **keeps negations** (not/no/nor/never); `unicode-v1` tokenizer (casefold + NFKC + `\w+`; `ascii-v1` = v1's `[a-z]+`); `weighting: binary-cosine` (default) or `bm25 {k1: 1.2, b: 0.75}` with IDF over the labeled pool only. Pure Python, no NLTK download.
- Implements the `Retriever` interface. Phase 3.

## Definition of done

Specs first: v1 fingerprint and selections unchanged; v2 drops stop words but keeps negations; digits/non-ASCII tokens survive; BM25 matches a hand-computed fixture; deterministic ties by ID. `make test` green. Cost: $0.

## Acceptance scenario

```gherkin
Feature: Lexical retriever v2 with stop words on by default
  Scenario: Negations survive stop-word removal
    Given two labeled items that differ only by "not"
    When lexical v2 tokenizes them with default settings
    Then common stop words are dropped and "not" is kept
  Scenario: Version 1 is unchanged
    Given an artifact saved with lexical retrieval version 1
    When it is reloaded
    Then its fingerprint and selected examples are identical to before
```

## Design

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §4.2, §4.3, Appendix A.

## Companion-project coordination

- [Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/tree/main/project/issues): `decision-flywheel-evaluations-e9cfcb6f-2fca-4f4b-b0b2-0a514067828a`.

These are cross-repository references; local Kanbus blocked-by relationships encode prerequisites within this repository.

comments.text:
Implemented on branch `phase3-retrieval` (worktree Decision-Flywheel-phase3), commits 0b15981 and fed787d; not merged or pushed. Offline only: specs use fake embedders, no network. `make test` equivalent: 289 passed (226 existing + 63 new).

- `LexicalRetriever(stopwords="en-v1", tokenizer="unicode-v1", weighting="binary-cosine", k1=1.2, b=0.75)`; config kind `lexical`, version `2`.
- Vendored `en-v1` stop list keeps not/no/nor/never, contraction fragments (t, didn, don) and contrast/intensity words; a spec pins its hash. `none` disables it.
- Weightings: binary-cosine (v1's overlap), tfidf-cosine, bm25 (IDF over the labeled pool only). k1/b enter the fingerprint only for bm25.
- Specs: v1 name/version/fingerprint pinned (`9a25d4e3...`) and `context.py` unchanged; v2 with `stopwords=none, tokenizer=ascii-v1` selects exactly like v1; BM25 matches a hand-computed fixture; ties by ascending ID.
- Label balance is always on in the context policy because the shared firewall requires exactly k per label; unbalanced (global) neighbours are used only by the purity proxy.
